description: This file contains utility functions for parsing and analyzing XML test result files, including functions to open test results, identify test cases, and determine test statuses such as skipped, passed, failed, or excluded.

methods.name: open_test_results
methods.description: Reads XML test result files from a directory and returns a list of parsed XML trees.

methods.name: get_testcases
methods.description: Extracts all 'testcase' elements from a list of XML trees.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a test case that satisfies a given condition.

methods.name: skipped_test
methods.description: Checks if a test case was skipped.

methods.name: passed_test
methods.description: Checks if a test case passed.

methods.name: key
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a test case based on its attributes.

methods.name: get_passed_testcases
methods.description: Returns all test cases that passed.

methods.name: get_excluded_testcases
methods.description: Returns all test cases that are excluded based on specific criteria.

methods.name: excluded_testcase
methods.description: Checks if a test case is excluded due to a specific skipped message.

methods.name: is_unexpected_success
methods.description: Checks if a test case indicates an unexpected success.

methods.name: is_passing_skipped_test
methods.description: Checks if a skipped test case has a specific message indicating it can be removed.

methods.name: is_failure
methods.description: Checks if a test case failed without being an unexpected success.
